richtext.rn7c868a9: We encourage open communication and welcome any concerns that may affect our stakeholders or partners, or the communities they serve.
richtext.rn2014440d: You can contact us directly here, via our Contact form, or report anonymously through NAVEX Global. While this risk and compliance platform addresses concerns related to the Trafigura Group, it also deals with potential grievances related to the Foundation’s activities. This service is available 24/7 for all stakeholders.
